features.label: Customized material options
features.text: Select standard doeskin for a breathable everyday fabric or sensil silicone grip for enhanced anti migration hold against the skin.

features.text: Optional doeskin extension liners provide additional thigh cuff length and surface area to comfortably accommodate patients with larger leg circumferences.

features.label: Seamless brace compatibility

features.label: Exact configuration match
features.text: Specifically designed to align with your original brace layout whether you require right lateral, left medial, right medial, or left lateral compartment offloading.

features.text: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with US-based brace specialists.
